messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: SEV P1 Alert: edge-lb (us-west-2) showing elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts. 5xx spike started ~2026-03-15T09:12Z, current 5xx = 7.8% (baseline 0.3%). Paging eng-sre and infra teams.

Sam W: ack — I'm oncall. grabbing dashboards. anyone seen any recent LB/Envoy rollouts?

Dave SRE: I didn't push anything in the last 24h. Checking routing configs and recent route weights now.

Mei (eng-sre): I'm seeing a pattern: errors concentrated on requests routed to "model-proxy-usw2" cluster, latency then 502/504. Traffic shift graph shows a shadowed route that spiked around the same time.

Sam W: putting mitigation options up front: 1) disable per-route retries for the problematic route, 2) roll back the last route weight change, 3) open circuit-breaker thresholds to fail-open temporarily. Which is lowest-risk?

Dave SRE: quick win = disable retries for that route. If retries are amplifying failures they can cascade. I'll patch the Envoy route to remove retry_policy for the route. Doing a dry-run in staging first.

Mei (eng-sre): +1. Also queue up a config to pin healthy upstream subset (reduce shard fanout) if we need to narrow blast radius.

Sam W: ops-bot, run the canary update to remove retries on model-proxy-usw2 route (20% -> 50% -> 100%). Report back at each step.

ops-bot: Canary started: 20% of edge nodes updated to new route config (no retry_policy) — rollout id r-41321-canary1.

Sam W: curl check against a problematic endpoint (repro):
```bash
curl -v 'https://edge.redwood.example/v1/generate?model=fast-lm' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -w '\nHTTP_CODE:%{http_code} TIME_TOTAL:%{time_total}\n'
```
Initial curl from a routed node: HTTP_CODE:502 TIME_TOTAL:1.22

Dave SRE: Staging canary looks OK (no retry_policy). Proceeding to 50% if metrics don't regress in 2m.

Mei (eng-sre): Dashboards: 5xx rate on the problem cluster dropped from 7.8% -> 3.1% after 20% rollout. Latency p95 improved too. Looks promising.

Sam W: Continue to 100% and monitor. Communicate to product for customer notification draft.

ops-bot: Rollout to 50% complete (r-41321-canary1). No regressions observed.

Dave SRE: Rolling to 100% now. Patch applied to all edge nodes, verifying config consistency with `envoy configdump`.

Sam W: After 100% rollout: 5xx back down to 0.5% over last 5m. Root cause hypothesis: route-level retry_policy with retry_on: 5xx + high max_retries caused retry amplification when a small subset of upstreams returned 5xx, triggering circuit breakers and increased load to already struggling upstreams.

Mei (eng-sre): Evidence: Envoy stats show per-host pending requests spike at same timestamps as retries. Also found an odd shadow route entry that duplicated the primary route for the same prefix and had different cluster weights — looks like a stale config fragment from a prior rollout.

Dave SRE: Found this snippet in the route config (stale fragment):
```yaml
- match: { prefix: "/v1/generate" }
  route:
    cluster: model-proxy-usw2
    retry_policy:
      retry_on: "5xx,connect,refused-stream"
      num_retries: 4
```
That + a shadowed route with slightly different cluster weight caused requests to be retried against a small subset repeatedly.

Sam W: Customer impact: product telemetry shows a subset of PLG customers had increased 502s and timeouts; some webhook timeouts as well. Jess, can you coordinate a customer comms note? Short status + mitigation + ask to contact support if customers see persistent errors.

Jess (product): On it. Drafting a brief: "We experienced elevated errors across some API calls from 09:12Z; mitigation applied and error rates returned to normal by 09:18Z. If you still see issues, please open a ticket and include request IDs." Will post to status.redwood once you confirm final wording.

Sam W: Running follow-up checks: running `envoy configdump` searches across clusters for duplicate route prefixes and route fragments older than 24h. Also creating an automated lint in the deployment pipeline to prevent orphaned route fragments.

Dave SRE: Action items (preliminary):
- Revert any route-shard shadowing patterns to single canonical route per prefix (owner: eng-runtime)
- Add deployment lint to block stale route fragments (owner: eng-infra)
- Update runbook: when 5xx spike, first step disable per-route retries and isolate cluster (owner: eng-sre)
- Postmortem within 48h with RCA and timeline (owner: Sam W)

Mei (eng-sre): Handoff: I'm done for this shift. Sam, can you take postmortem lead? Dave can you be secondary?

Sam W: I will take PM lead. Dave as secondary. Jess will handle customer comms. I'll update the incident channel with the final postmortem link.

ops-bot: Incident marked resolved. Duration ~6 minutes. Incident record: incident-41321.

Sam W: closing notes — root cause: env config state where a stale/shadow route + aggressive retry_policy induced amplification and triggered circuits. Mitigation: removed retry_policy on route, rolled out config, monitor. Will schedule a follow-up to harden deployment checks. :white_check_mark:

Jess (product): Posted status page update. Will sync with support on any late reports.

Dave SRE: leaving a quick grep command for the postmortem to find suspicious fragments:
```bash
# find duplicate route prefixes in configdumps
jq -r '.configs[] | select(.static_resources != null) | .static_resources.listeners[]?.filter_chains[]?.filters[]?.typed_config | .route_config.virtual_hosts[]?.routes[]?.match.prefix' *.configdump | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head
```
Sam W: Thanks everyone. I'll draft the postmortem and include timeline + metrics + action owners. If anyone remembers who pushed the stray fragment, tag them in the doc.

oncall-bot: If a follow-up escalation is needed, react with :rotating_light: to this thread.
